ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 80-85% of the visible ventral area, with low-intensity black restricted to the periphery and trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region composed of high-intensity white; continuous low-intensity black border along the entire trailing edge; localized brownish-yellow organic staining in the lower-medial and lower-right quadrants; one distinct dark circular pixel cluster in the lower-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression at the center; estimated vertex angle between 50-60 degrees with a significant vertical depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extensive high-amplitude serrations and jagged peaks (amplitude 5-15 pixels) along the length of the trailing edge, with maximum irregularity observed at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep curve extending from the median notch to the outer tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast textured clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization on distal lobe tips; extensive yellowish-brown pigmentation/staining across the lower ventral surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated dark focal spot (approximate 10x10 pixel area) located in the lower-right lobe quadrant.
